package.description: A general research-report template with six controlled evidence and analysis scenes.

body_variants.best_for: Three genuinely parallel ideas with comparable visual weight.
A linear method, experiment pipeline, or work plan where order matters.
One dominant figure plus a concise interpretation rail.
Three sibling metrics that should be compared at a glance.
Two balanced alternatives or phases with a short synthesis.
Several short evidence snippets supporting one claim.
